name: @barty13/pi-opencode-bridge
description: Delegate threads to a local OpenCode service from Pi. oc_open returns at once, the thread settling opens a later turn.
author: Barty <Barty13@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.check: for c in 4xx nowatch expire stale dup ceiling handle; do CASE=$c bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts || exit 1; done && (BRIDGE=file://$PWD/.control-bridge.ts CASE=stale bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && (BRIDGE=file://$PWD/.control-bridge.ts CASE=dup bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-1-compact.ts && (BRIDGE=file://$PWD/.control-compact.ts bun run checks/check-1-compact.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-4-gate.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-nogate.ts bun run checks/check-4-gate.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-6-digest.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-digest.ts bun run checks/check-6-digest.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-7-steer.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-steer.ts bun run checks/check-7-steer.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-8-attach.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-attach.ts bun run checks/check-8-attach.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-9-rewind.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-rewind.ts bun run checks/check-9-rewind.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-10-budget.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-budget.ts bun run checks/check-10-budget.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-11-fanout.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-fanout.ts bun run checks/check-11-fanout.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-12-docs.ts && (BRIDGE=$PWD/.control-docs.ts bun run checks/check-12-docs.ts; [ $? -eq 1 ]) && bun run checks/check-13-panes.ts
